description: Starter registry of Colorado legislative and executive institutions, expanded with agency identities referenced by the public-sector AI inventory. Agency site links remain empty until physical locations are separately verified.

institutions.name: Colorado General Assembly
institutions.notes: Colorado's bicameral state legislature, composed of the Senate and House of Representatives.

institutions.name: Colorado Senate
institutions.notes: Upper chamber of the Colorado General Assembly; listed by the General Assembly among the institutions housed in the Capitol.

institutions.name: Colorado House of Representatives
institutions.notes: Lower chamber of the Colorado General Assembly; listed by the General Assembly among the institutions housed in the Capitol.

institutions.name: Office of the Governor of Colorado
institutions.notes: The General Assembly's Capitol visitor information identifies the Governor's Office as housed in the Capitol.

institutions.name: Office of the Lieutenant Governor of Colorado
institutions.notes: The General Assembly's Capitol visitor information identifies the Lieutenant Governor's Office as housed in the Capitol.

institutions.name: Office of the Colorado State Treasurer
institutions.notes: The State Treasurer is an independently elected constitutional officer whose office is located in the State Capitol. The Treasurer oversees the Department of the Treasury; this record identifies the elected office and its Capitol site, not every department facility.

institutions.name: Colorado Secretary of State
institutions.notes: Statewide elected executive office responsible for election administration and other statutory public services. The official Capitol visitor guide identifies its office at 1700 Broadway, not inside the Capitol.

institutions.name: Colorado Governor's Office of Information Technology
institutions.notes: Statewide technology authority. Agency-specific AI systems may be managed by the owning department; OIT policy and support do not by themselves establish operational ownership. No physical site is linked in this pilot record; the Atlas does not infer a headquarters or service location from this inventory.

institutions.name: Colorado Department of Labor and Employment
institutions.notes: Agency owner for the unemployment-insurance and workers' compensation GenAI projects described in the State's published project inventory. No physical site is linked in this pilot record; the Atlas does not infer a headquarters or service location from this inventory.

institutions.name: Colorado Department of Health Care Policy and Financing
institutions.notes: Agency owner for Colorado Benefits Management System (CBMS) and Medicaid-related projects described in the State's published GenAI project inventory. No physical site is linked in this pilot record; the Atlas does not infer a headquarters or service location from this inventory.

institutions.name: Colorado Department of Public Health and Environment
institutions.notes: Agency owner for the CEOS chatbot improvement project described in the State's published GenAI project inventory. No physical site is linked in this pilot record; the Atlas does not infer a headquarters or service location from this inventory.

institutions.name: Colorado Department of Corrections
institutions.notes: Agency owner for the planned Recidiviz project described in the State's published GenAI project inventory. No physical site is linked in this pilot record; the Atlas does not infer a headquarters or service location from this inventory.

institutions.name: Colorado Department of Personnel and Administration
institutions.notes: Agency owner for the HR Expert Systems pilot described in the State's published GenAI project inventory. No physical site is linked in this pilot record; the Atlas does not infer a headquarters or service location from this inventory.
